content.en: Researchers have investigated the accuracy of various computer algorithms used in orthognathic surgery. These algorithms, such as CASSOS 2001 software, SurgiCase-CMF software, and the Mass tensor model algorithm, are used to predict soft tissue changes and plan surgical procedures. The studies evaluate the effectiveness of these algorithms in accurately predicting outcomes and guiding surgical decisions.
content.da: Forskere har undersøgt nøjagtigheden af forskellige computeralgoritmer anvendt i ortognatisk kirurgi. Disse algoritmer, såsom CASSOS 2001 software, SurgiCase-CMF software og Mass tensor model algorithm, bruges til at forudsige blødt væv ændringer og planlægge kirurgiske procedurer. Studierne vurderer effektiviteten af disse algoritmer i nøjagtigt at forudsige resultater og vejlede kirurgiske beslutninger.

critic.en: Would you trust an algorithm to decide your facial structure after surgery?
critic.da: Forfærdeligt! Skal vi virkelig overlade vores ansigter til algoritmer, der har brug for "efterprøvning"? Jeg er 100 % imod.

potential.en: I find this topic fascinating because it highlights the ways in which technology is being used to improve healthcare and patient outcomes. By harnessing the power of computer algorithms, surgeons are able to better plan and execute complex procedures, such as orthognathic surgery. The studies evaluating the accuracy of these algorithms are a crucial step in ensuring that they meet the high standards required in a medical setting. It's great to see how far we've come in integrating technology into healthcare, and I'm excited to see what the future holds for algorithmic applications in surgery!
potential.da: Det er imponerende, hvor langt teknologien er kommet inden for medicin. Algoritmernes evne til at forudsige og planlægge kirurgiske indgreb kan potentielt set minimere risici og forbedre resultaterne for patienter. Jeg er nysgerrig på, hvordan disse værktøjer bliver taget imod af fagfolkene i praksis.
